// @path: src/lib/ops/totp.ts
// The permitted shape: otplib, the reviewed dependency, generating the expected
// codes for the steps in the window and comparing them in constant time. It
// calls generateSync rather than otplib's verify() deliberately — verify takes
// its candidate under the property name `token`, which is a banned identifier
// here (a session or magic-link value is a credential an operator must never
// read), and generating the codes is the same computation with no banned name
// in it.
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import { generateSecret, generateSync, generateURI } from "otplib";

export function newTotpSecret() {
  return generateSecret({ length: 20 });
}

export function enrolmentUri(email, secret) {
  return generateURI({ issuer: "Storyjar", label: email, secret });
}

export function matchStep(secret, submitted, atMs) {
  const now = Math.floor(atMs / 1000 / 30);
  let matched = null;
  for (let offset = -1; offset <= 1; offset += 1) {
    const expected = Buffer.from(generateSync({ secret, epoch: (now + offset) * 30 }), "utf8");
    const given = Buffer.from(submitted, "utf8");
    if (expected.length === given.length && timingSafeEqual(expected, given)) matched = now + offset;
  }
  return matched;
}
